purpose: Frozen data-generating-process regimes for Gate 0A, organized into three tiers. The result of a compression comparison is entirely determined by where causal signal sits relative to the genotype variance/LD spectrum, so the regime set is pre-registered before any run and each regime is decided SEPARATELY (no pooled cross-regime average).
trait_model: y = g + e ; h2 = Var(g) / (Var(g) + Var(e))
genetic_value_available: g is known by construction and is the primary decision target (see R2_genetic)
polygenic_background: every regime carries a diffuse polygenic background in addition to its named causal component

spectral_tail_adversarial.causal_placement: SNPs in the low-variance spectral tail, orthogonal to the leading block PCs; top genotype variance carries little/no causal signal
spectral_tail_adversarial.role: THE PRIMARY DECISION REGIME. Unsupervised reconstruction optimizes genotype variance, which has no reason to align with trait-causal directions; this regime asks directly whether spectral compression discards phenotype signal while keeping LD

major_LD_aligned.causal_placement: SNPs loading heavily on the leading block PCs / strong LD directions

low_MAF_additive.role: MAF-axis control; interacts with standardization choice

within_block_additive.causal_placement: additive effects within a single block

between_block_additive.causal_model: y = beta_A G_A + beta_B G_B for SNPs in distant blocks
between_block_additive.role: DISTRIBUTED POLYGENIC control, explicitly NOT long-range interaction; tests whether per-block compression loses additive signal spread across blocks

within_block_interaction.causal_model: y includes gamma * G_i * G_j for SNP pairs inside one block, plus polygenic background
within_block_interaction.note: a linear ridge cannot read out an interaction from any representation; the bilinear head is applied identically to every arm

between_block_interaction.causal_model: y includes gamma * G_A * G_B across distant blocks, plus polygenic background
between_block_interaction.role: the TRUE long-range test and the only regime that is direct evidence for cross-block (Grassmann-style) structure

primary.name: bilinear_cross_product_ridge
primary.definition: features = z_A (x) z_B (Kronecker cross-product of the two block representations); ridge on those features. Because z_A^T W z_B = vec(W)^T (z_B (x) z_A), this is still a CONVEX linear ridge, just with cross-block product inputs.
primary.why_primary: adds ONLY the between-block product terms that are the thing to detect; excludes z_A^2, z_B^2 and within-block quadratics, so a positive result is attributable to between-block interaction rather than an incidental within-block quadratic
primary.attribution: all arms accept the identical cross-block bilinear readout; if a compression preserves interaction better, the difference comes from the representation, not the head

robustness.name: full_degree2_polynomial_ridge
robustness.definition: ridge on the full degree-2 polynomial expansion phi_2([z_A, z_B]) (coordinates + all pairwise products including squares)

matched_interaction_head.dimension_cap: cross-product / polynomial dimension capped by the representation budget; recorded in the cost ledger

exploratory_regimes_secondary_only.common_causal: additive on common variants; MAF-axis companion to low_MAF_additive
exploratory_regimes_secondary_only.high_LD_vs_low_LD: additive on high- vs low-LD SNPs; LD-axis sensitivity

traits_per_regime.note: the number of independent simulation replicates R per regime is fixed by the detectability gate to reach >=0.90 power at the primary margin 0.005; 20 is likely underpowered at h2=0.05, N~2247
